1195.tooltip: Become tiny, gain 20% Movement Speed, and deal between 10% and 30% bonus damage to champions based on how much larger they are than you.

1335.name: Goldrend
1335.text: Damaging a champion with Attacks or Abilities deals additional magic damage, and grants you Gold and Movement Speed.

1041.name: Goliath
1041.text: Become large, gaining 35% Health and 15% Adaptive Force.
1041.tooltip: Become large, gaining 35% Health and 15% Adaptive Force.

1389.name: Hand of Baron
1389.text: Gain 25% Adaptive Force. Nearby allied minions are greatly empowered.
1389.tooltip: Gain 25% Adaptive Force. Nearby allied minions are greatly empowered.

2107.name: Hellbent
2107.text: Damaging enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants stacks. At max stacks, you revive empowered upon death.
2107.tooltip:
Striking enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants you a stack of Revivemaxxing for 6 seconds (max: 10). At max stacks become Hellbent.

This has a 90 second cooldown.

1392.name: Holy Snowball
1392.text: Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball. You are briefly Invulnerable when you dash with Snowball. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
1392.tooltip:
Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball.

You become Invulnerable for 1.5 seconds when you dash with Snowball.

If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

1361.name: Icathia's Fall
1361.text: Immediately: Gain a Bami's Cinder. QUEST: Possess Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance. REWARD: These Items combine into Void Immolation.
1361.tooltip:
Immediately: Gain a Bami's Cinder.

Requirement: Possess Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance.

Reward: Combine Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance into Void Immolation.

1045.name: Infernal Conduit
1045.text: Your Abilities apply stacking Burn that deals damage over time. Your Burn effects reduce your basic Ability Cooldowns.
1045.tooltip: All your Burn effects lower your basic Ability Cooldowns by 0.08 seconds when they damage enemy champions.

1388.name: Infinite Recursion
1388.text: Gain 60 Ability Haste, plus 3 Ability Haste per takedown.
1388.tooltip: Gain 60 Ability Haste, plus 3 Ability Haste per takedown.

1048.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
1048.tooltip: Your Abilities can Critically Strike for 45% increased damage.

1337.name: King Me
1337.text: The first time you take the enemy transport with a Legendary Item you become Kinged, upgrading your item and gaining a random Prismatic Augment.
1337.tooltip: The first time you take the enemy transport with a Legendary Item you become Kinged, upgrading your item and gaining a random Prismatic Augment.

1053.name: Mad Scientist
1053.text: On each Revive, you grow large (gaining Adaptive Force and Health) or tiny (gaining Ability Haste and Movement Speed).
1053.tooltip: On each Revive, you grow large (gaining 30% Adaptive Force and 20% Health) or tiny (gaining 70 Ability Haste and 40% Movement Speed).

1054.name: Master of Duality
1054.text: Your Attacks grant you stacking Ability Power and your Abilities that damage enemies grant you Attack Damage.
1054.tooltip: This buff stacks and refreshes infinitely but lasts 5 seconds.

2055.name: Multishot
2055.text: REWARD: Fire additional missiles per Quest Level.
2055.tooltip: REWARD: Fire additional missiles per Quest Level.

1058.name: Mystic Punch
1058.text: On-Hit reduce the cooldown of your abilities by 1.25 seconds .
1058.tooltip: On-Hit reduce the cooldown of your abilities by 1.25 seconds .

1332.name: Ominous Pact
1332.text: Gain Ability Power, Movement Speed, and Omnivamp based on missing Health, taking damage each time you cast.
1332.tooltip:
Spell casts cost 5% of your current Health.

Max benefit at 30% Health.

2123.name: Overloaded
2123.text: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of your chosen ability.
2123.tooltip:
Using another Ability resets the cooldown of your chosen ability.

"They come for the scroll... Stick to the plan... EQEQEQ..." — The Blue One

12317.name: Pandora's Box
12317.text: Transmute all of your augments into random PrismaticAugments.
12317.tooltip: Transmute all of your augments into random PrismaticAugments.

2135.name: Pin Cushion
2135.text: Attacks during your chosen ability gouge your target with Nails. Nails accumulate damage, execute, and grant Movement Speed upon expiration.
2135.tooltip:
Attacks during your chosen ability gouge your target with Nails.

Nails will explode early and execute if the accumulated damage would kill the enemy champion.

1421.name: Prom Queen
1421.text: Every 35 seconds, Autocast a sparkly tiara descends upon you. When it lands, gain Rakan's Ultimate, charming enemies you touch.
1421.tooltip: Every 35 seconds, Autocast a sparkly tiara descends upon you. When it lands, gain Rakan's Ultimate, charming enemies you touch.

2099.name: Rite of Ascension
2099.text: On takedown, enemy champions leave behind their Essence. Attacking the Essence grants movement speed and resets basic ability cooldowns.
2099.tooltip:
Champion takedowns within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds. Attacking an Essence consumes it.

Today, you will see the power of Ascension! — Azir, the Emperor of the Sands

2072.name: Spell Split
2072.text: Your your chosen ability missile splits into two on hit, at max Range, or when Recast.
2072.tooltip:
Your your chosen ability missile splits into two on hit, at max Range, or when Recast.

Enemies take less damage if hit by the same spell.

2104.name: Spirit Bomb
2104.text: Healing and Shielding allied champions builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the bomb onto lowest Health ally to heal and shield them and nearby allies.
2104.tooltip: Healing and Shielding builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the Spirit Bomb at your lowest Health ally.

2115.name: Squishy Slappy Grab
2115.text: Occasionally send out squishy, slappy hands towards all nearby enemy champions, tethering them. Your next attack will pull in all tethered enemies.
2115.tooltip:
Occasionally send out Squishy Slappy Hands that latch on to all nearby enemy champions for 4 seconds.

This has a 30 second cooldown.

1402.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
1402.text: Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils! On your next Augment selection, gain one additional reroll per slot.
1402.tooltip:
Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!

On your next Augment selection, gain one additional reroll per slot.

1413.name: Stuck In Here With Me
1413.text: Using your Ultimate Taunts nearby enemies and grants you damage reduction. Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste.

2134.name: Surge Field
2134.text: On Ultimate cast, spawn a Zone that grants Ability Haste and Movement Speed. While inside, it fires missiles that deal 20% of your damage.
2134.tooltip:
On ultimate cast, spawn a Zone around you. While in it, gain 50 Ability Haste, 40% Movement Speed, and fire missiles that deal 20% of damage dealt to enemies.

The Zone follows you the first time you leave it and expires after a short duration the second time you do so.

1079.name: Symphony of War
1079.text: Gain the Lethal Tempo and Conqueror Keystone Runes.
1079.tooltip:
Gain the Lethal Tempo and Conqueror Keystone Runes.
Lethal Tempo - Attacking champions grants Attack Speed, stacking up to 6 times. At 6 stacks, your Attacks launch a bolt that deals additional damage.
Conqueror: Gain stacks of Adaptive Force when attacking enemy champions. After reaching 12 stacks, heal for a portion of damage you deal to champions.

1081.name: Tap Dancer
1081.text: Your Attacks grant you Movement Speed. Gain Attack Speed based on your Movement Speed.
1081.tooltip:
Your Attacks grant you 10 Movement Speed.

The buff stacks and refreshes infinitely but lasts 5 seconds.

1001.name: Titan's Resolve
1001.text: Gain stacks when taking or dealing damage. For every 10 stacks, gain Adaptive Force, Armor, Magic Resist, Size, and Tenacity.
1001.tooltip:
Dealing and receiving champion damage grants you 1 stack of Juggernauting for 6 seconds.

Stacks fall off faster the more you have.

2005.name: Triggered Inferno
2005.text: Gain Daredevil Impulse. When you reach S Style, automatically use Inferno Trigger.
2005.tooltip:
Damaging enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities different from the previous one grants Style (from F to S).

At S Style consume your Style to unleash a torrent of gunshots at all nearby enemies 10 times over 2 seconds.

Shots apply Lifesteal and deal 25% damage to minions.

2054.name: Tripleshot
2054.text: Your your chosen ability targets 2 additional enemies in front of you.
2054.tooltip:
Your your chosen ability targets 2 additional enemies in front of you.

Units take less damage from the same spell.

1349.name: Ultimate Awakening
1349.text: Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste. After using your Ultimate, refresh your basic abilities and gain 300 basic ability haste for 15s. (20s Cooldown)
1349.tooltip:
Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste.
After using your Ultimate, refresh your basic abilities and gain 300 basic ability haste for 15s. (20s Cooldown)

1088.name: Ultimate Revolution
1088.text: Refresh your Ultimate after casting it (75 seconds Cooldown or reset on death).
1088.tooltip: Refresh your Ultimate after casting it (75 seconds Cooldown or reset on death).

2141.name: Ultra Hydra
2141.text: Gain a Tiamat when completing a Hydra Item. QUEST: Gain Ravenous Hydra, Profane Hydra and Titanic Hydra. REWARD: Gain Ultra Hydra.
2141.tooltip:
Gain a Tiamat when completing a Hydra Item.

QUEST: Gain Ravenous Hydra, Profane Hydra and Titanic Hydra.

REWARD: Gain Ultra Hydra.

1379.name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn
1379.text: Gain 100% Attack Speed. Increase Sword of Blossoming Dawn's healing to 250% when you attack enemy champions.
1379.tooltip:
Gain 100% Attack Speed.

Increase Sword of Blossoming Dawn's healing to 250% when you attack enemy champions.

1095.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
1095.text: Your Healing and Shielding also increases the target's Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds.

1156.name: Wooglet's Witchcap
1156.text: Immediately gain a Needlessly Large Rod. QUEST: Possess Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass. REWARD: Gain Wooglet's Witchcap.
1156.tooltip:
Immediately gain a Needlessly Large Rod.

QUEST: Possess Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass.

REWARD: Gain Wooglet's Witchcap.
